items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Trixie Smith, who worked with Miss Bargorne for Mae West.

ctx.x: And they had about five or six entertainers all the time. One time when I was there with Harry White, they had Mamie Smith, Clara Smith... They weren't sisters, because they mentioned it, both of them. "She ain't no sister of mine," Clara said, and Mamie said, "God, she ain't no sister of mine." That's all the Smith sisters. There was Mamie Smith, Clara Smith, and later, in about two or three weeks, Trixie Smith, who worked with Miss Bargorne for Mae West. All those were Blues singers. There was Margie Sith(?).…
